subject: Invite cadence, API key seeding and KMS handshake for Novacare tenant
messages:
From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@novacare.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novacare tenant: initial activation window and invites

Hi Sofia and Monica,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday — Tom and I reviewed the onboarding checklist and wanted to lock down the invite cadence and API key approach before the kickoff next week. Two quick asks from our side:  

1) We need a simple admin/user role map so we can pre-create the user roster in our HR system and send invites in waves (pilot -> dev -> prod).
2) We'd like to use our KMS to manage keys; can you confirm the handshake steps and any required IAM roles on our side?

Proposed constraints: keep the pilot workspace isolated (no shared data), seed one service account for CI with rotate-every-90-days, and delay prod invites until API keys are in place.

Would appreciate a short mutual action plan and a suggested invite cadence (who gets invites and when). Attaching our internal org chart for the pilot members.

Best,
Ayesha
Director of Platform
Novacare Health
[Attachment: novacare-pilot-orgchart.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@novacare.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 17:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novacare tenant: initial activation window and invites

Thanks Ayesha — great questions. Below is a short plan we can execute in the kickoff sprint (I trimmed to the essentials so your team can map tasks).

Mutual action plan (high-level):
- Day 0 (kickoff): finalize pilot roster and confirm KMS vendor details.
- Day 1–2: Redwood seeds pilot workspace, creates three projects (pilot, staging, prod) and two admin seats.
- Day 3: We hand over ephemeral service-account credentials for CI (scoped to pilot).
- Day 4–7: Pilot invites sent (admins + 5 power users), monitoring configured; API key rotation policy documented.
- Post-pilot: once smoke tests OK, we seed prod API keys and open invites by role groups.

Invite cadence recommendation (concise):
- Pilot: invite admins + power users together (single wave).
- Staging: invite devs/testers in small batches (2–3 waves).
- Prod: invite by department after API key and KMS integration.

KMS handshake notes (what we need from you):
- KMS vendor and key ARN (or HSM contact)
- A service account email on your side we can grant Encrypt/Decrypt permissions to (we'll provide a minimal IAM template).
- Confirmation if you require envelope encryption from our side.

Attached: initial-roles.csv (simple CSV with role -> Redwood permission mapping) and a short invite cadence doc (novacare-invite-cadence.md).

If that looks good I can hand off to Jonas to detail the API key seeding steps and service-account naming.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
[Attachment: initial-roles.csv (csv)]
[Attachment: novacare-invite-cadence.md (md)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@novacare.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novacare tenant: initial activation window and invites

Dropping the technical playbook here — short, prescriptive steps so your SRE can follow them verbatim during the kickoff.

API key / service-account seeding (pilot):
1) We'll create three projects: novacare-pilot, novacare-staging, novacare-prod. Each gets a project-scoped API key.
2) For CI, we recommend a service account named sa-novacare-ci@redwood-externals. That account will be given only token:generate and token:revoke on novacare-pilot.
3) Key distribution: we provide a one-time encrypted bundle (signed by Redwood) that your KMS can unwrap; after unwrapping you must rotate the keys and confirm rotation to us.
4) Rotation policy we enforce: 90 days for CI keys; 30 days for stale personal tokens.

Service-account naming guidelines are attached (service-account-naming-guidelines.txt). On the KMS side we need:
- Key policy allowing encrypt/decrypt for sa-novacare-ci@redwood-externals and an admin principal from Novacare.
- A contact for the HSM/KMS admin (name + email).

Quick security notes:
- We will enable prefix caching for the pilot workspace but not for prod until you opt in.
- We'll add an audit hook for admin actions and share the first 30 days of logs.

Links:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/novacare 
- Implementation ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-475

If Novacare can provide the KMS ARN and a rotation contact by EOD Thu we'll be ready to seed keys on Fri.

—Jonas
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
[Attachment: service-account-naming-guidelines.txt (txt)]

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@novacare.io>

Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novacare tenant: initial activation window and invites

Thanks all — this is clear and doable. A couple of clarifications from our infra team:  

- KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345 (we'll send formal IAM policy later).
- Service account name OK; prefer sa-novacare-ci@novacare.io (we will create and grant the Redwood principal).
- On invite cadence: please hold prod invitations until we confirm SCIM sync (targeting 2027-06-21).

We'll aim to send the rotation contact and a draft IAM policy by EOD Thu. Proceed with pilot seeding once you confirm the exact principal we should grant Encrypt/Decrypt.

Appreciate the clear plan — looking forward to the kickoff.

Tom Reynolds
CTO, Novacare Health
